notes: Run Twists! On the map screen, tap the new Twists bar to bend the rules of your next run and earn bonus Shards.

Pick up to 3 of 10: Glass Cannon, Swarm, Giants, Hasty, Bloodless, Fast Learner, Eternal Night, Bomb Party, Frenzy and Paper Tigers. Tap Random for a surprise, or Daily for the same two twists everyone gets today (your best Daily time is remembered).
Your twists show as little icons at the top of the screen during the run and are listed on the results screen.
